# detected media type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:detectedMediaType`](gmeow-detectedMediaType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/detectedMediaType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

The MIME media type DETECTED from the bytes/magic of an information object (the observed type). May disagree with a filename's [`gmeow:claimedMediaType`](gmeow-claimedMediaType.md) — a mismatch is recorded, not reasoned into a contradiction. Non-functional.
